selection: Explicit common-word candidates found by inspecting all unclassified primary labels in the pinned 2012 and 2026 corpora. This is a targeted vocabulary expansion, not an exhaustive dictionary or a blind validation set. Apply every rule to every cohort, including 2000/2004. Multilingual glosses are explicit editorial proposals in Chinese, Japanese, Russian and Arabic as well as Latin-script languages; no native-speaker validation has been conducted. Ambiguous movement/location labels are not assigned from translation alone.
normalization: lowercase Unicode to IDNA A-label; exact whole-label equality only, no substring or applicant-name matching
